decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster system builds directly on the firm's fluid handling and pump knowledge, enabling it to assimilate market feedback and improve the product, making a drop unlikely.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge leverages existing rotating equipment and filtration expertise, supporting learning from early results and reducing the likelihood of discontinuation.

The scraper belt chip conveyor is closely related to the firm's core conveyor and material-handling knowledge, allowing effective interpretation of results and continued development, so a drop is unlikely.
The hinged belt chip conveyor also aligns with established conveyor capabilities, enabling the firm to absorb feedback and refine the product, making withdrawal improbable.
